# Code of Conduct

## Standard

Project spaces should remain professional, technical, and usable.

Participants are expected to:

- discuss ideas and code rather than attack people
- provide reproducible evidence for technical claims where possible
- accept corrections when evidence changes
- avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, or deliberate disruption
- respect responsible security disclosure

## Maintainer actions

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content and may restrict participation when behavior materially harms the project or its contributors.

Moderation decisions should be proportional to the behavior and documented internally when significant.

## Scope

This applies to repository issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other official project spaces.
